qualifications: Research relay/facade only; no authenticated production companion endpoint is implemented. Both arms use the same relay and two browser sockets, with the companion idle in combined mode.
The relay forwards original native packets and browser ACKs; it never fabricates credit, retries media, or opens a second RFB/native session.

Both browser connections share the SAME aggregate 1 Mbit/s kernel queue per direction. The local relay/native hop is unshaped; cumulative native TCP_NODELAY readback describes that local hop. Relay sockets request NODELAY without retained OS readback.
First cohort fixes eight video frames in flight; the second fixes one. The audio routing comparison is within each cohort, not between unrelated direct/proxy records.
Original result bytes are unchanged. Source archives normalize tar metadata. The one-frame archive contains only two added files and inherits all 135 unchanged parent sources.
Controller CPU includes the relay, study scheduling, counters and IPC. Cumulative relay and kernel counters include warmup, outside the browser observation window.
Marker cadence covers its own region, not whole-frame coherence/fidelity, physical scanout or real window-manager behavior. Trigger-to-analyser/controller response is not physical speaker latency.

Source phase progresses; two repetitions per condition provide observations, not matched quality, statistical confidence or Internet-path guarantees. Late/unobserved outcomes and incomplete control sets are retained.
